# Abdalrahman Khairy

> Narrative brand strategist and brand identity designer based in Damietta, Egypt. Works with founders building brands across the Gulf and beyond (KSA, UAE, Jordan, Egypt): brand strategy, naming, narrative, visual identity and packaging. Also mentors designers one to one.
